dedupe_keys.name: madia italian agro meteorological grids and climate normals 1981 2021

description: MADIA is CREA’s gridded agro-meteorological dataset for Italy, derived from ERA5 surface reanalysis for 1981–2021. It contains minimum, mean and maximum air temperature, humidity extremes, wind, solar radiation, precipitation and FAO Penman–Monteith reference evapotranspiration. The data use ten-day time steps and a quarter-degree grid. Climate normals and distribution statistics cover 1981–2010 and 1991–2020. Zenodo provides NetCDF and CSV files, metadata and vector cell-coverage fractions for Italian NUTS 2 and 3 areas in a public archive under CC BY 4.0, without charge. Spatial and temporal aggregation limit local drainage or short-duration storm modelling. Values are reanalysis-derived estimates, not a network of independent field measurements, and promised periodic updates were not verified beyond this release. A reviewer-assessed use is supplying weather and irrigation-demand context to agricultural water or climate-impact simulations. data-era5-reanalysis is the explicitly documented upstream source. No archive was downloaded or spatial comparison performed.
